Self-regulation occurs when an industry realizes that a free-for-all in a maturing market is not healthy and that regulation created by non-industry people can create an unhealthy industry as well. Enter self-regulation.

Industries become self-regulated by creating industry standards. 

The standards are often created by a commination of best practices, experience, and industry organizations that can converse with governments and help industry professionals create the frame work that will allow them to comply with industry guidelines. 

What about decentralization? Of course this is a dream of crypto enthusiasts but without a standards of decentralization comparing projects and programs on decentralization strategies; claiming decentralization is futile. 

With multiple caucuses or well outline standards, companies or projects can be audited for compliance in different standards for which that standard can be indicated has being met or not and recorded on a blockchain. 

As the compliance structure grows these factors can be written into blockchain contracts allowing for a non-biased way of auditing certain features.
